watchOut: Origination, termination and renewal fee amounts are not stated.
owner: Runs on The Southern Bank Company domain (sobanco.com)
name: altLINE
summary: Bank-run invoice factoring for carriers with a near-full advance and a published fee range.
differentiator: The widest published range we found, 0.90% to 3.50%, with a 99% to 100% advance. Unlike the fintech factors it lists the fees it does charge: an initial filing or origination fee, an early termination fee and a renewal fee, on 6 to 12 month contracts.

terms.rate: You can expect to pay 0.90% to 3.50% of the invoice value in factoring fees with altLINE
terms.contract: Standard freight factoring contracts are 6 to 12 months
terms.otherFees: Initial filing or origination fee; early termination fee; renewal fee. No debtor credit check, invoice processing or monthly portal fees.
terms.speed: Factored invoices are typically paid within 24 hours

bestFor: Established carriers with steady volume who can commit to 6 to 12 months.
skipIf: You want to leave at any time; there is an early termination fee.
